name: cyberprompt
description: Intent-preserving prompt optimization for Codex CLI, with a deterministic UserPromptSubmit gate, a GPT-5.6 Sol forge, audit logs, one-turn bypass, and instant on/off control.

interface.longDescription: Intercepts operator prompts in Codex CLI, applies a GPT-5.6 Sol normalization pass, rejects unproven or lossy rewrites with deterministic gates, and injects only a source-traceable advisory while the original remains authoritative.
